greeting.text: Hello! I can help with orders, returns, shipping, payments, pricing, and product questions.

goodbye.text: Goodbye. If you need anything else, support is available at +1-800-123-4567.

returns.text: Most items can be returned within 30 days if they are unused and in original packaging.

shipping.text: Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days, and express shipping takes 1 to 2 business days.

payments.text: We support major credit cards, debit cards, UPI, net banking, wallets, and EMI on eligible items.

pricing.text: Prices update in real time based on promotions, stock, and seller offers. Share a product name for more details.

product_info.text: Share the product name and I can provide general availability, delivery, and purchase guidance.

contact_support.text: You can reach customer support at +1-800-123-4567 or support@shopai.com.

fallback.text: I didn't fully understand that. You can ask me to track, cancel, or place an order, or ask about returns, shipping, payments, pricing, and support.
